title: Implement serialized run-lease controller
description: Own provider runs, continuation dispatch, retries, cancellation, reload, tree, compaction, and shutdown through explicit run leases and one serialized controller queue. Acceptance: stale events cannot charge, continue, or abort a replacement run; lifecycle fault tests pass.

logs.msg: Implemented extensions/pi-goal/controller.ts with one serialized mutation queue, explicit continuation leases, dispatch acknowledgement/supersession/timeout, and lifecycle effect ownership. Tests: controller.test.ts and index lifecycle cases.
